data.body: Implementation complete under RED->GREEN. All 11 AC-named tests present and passing. Key design decisions during landing: (1) Respected the jira_family import boundary — the shared reconciler layer (outbound_comments/outbound_differ) must NOT import a concrete codec, so _resolve_codec resolves the real codec via the NEUTRAL _backend_registry.select_backend seam (like _resolve_sanitizer), and the codec is injected via a new OutboundMapper.comment_codec port member (Cloud AdfCodec / DC WikiTextCodec, the same instance the mapper renders descriptions with). Threaded through compute_outbound_mutations -> _diff_comments. (2) Fixed a real rich-mode convergence bug: adf_to_markdown re-adds a trailing newline that the Jira side strips via _normalize_comment_body, so the local compare_body is now routed through the SAME _normalize_comment_body (symmetric) — this keeps comment-diff convergent when it renders rich (story requirement). (3) Updated the two deferral-guard test files (test_diff_comments_cutover_neutral, test_diff_comments_codec_normalization) which explicitly deferred comment rendering to THIS story; retargeted them to pin the migrated flag-governed behavior. make lint (ruff+complexity ratchet new=0/increased=0), make typecheck (mypy clean), and the full reconciler unit suite (2679 passed) are green. One unrelated PRE-EXISTING failure on clean origin/main: test_ref_lock.py::test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote (git cat-file plumbing in a tmp bare repo, macOS-only env). Next: commit + push to Gerrit.
